entries.title: Psalms 143:1
segments: ¶<<A Psalm of David.>> Hear my prayer, O LORD, give ear to my supplications: in thy faithfulness answer me, [and] in thy righteousness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:2
segments: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: for in thy sight shall no man living be justified.

entries.title: Psalms 143:3
segments: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

words.text: ; he hath made me to dwell
, as those that have been long

entries.title: Psalms 143:4
segments: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

entries.title: Psalms 143:5
segments: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

entries.title: Psalms 143:6
segments: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul [thirsteth] after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 143:7
segments: ¶Hear me speedily, O LORD: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit. {lest...: or, for I am become like, etc}

words.text: from me, lest I be like
. {lest...: or, for I am become like, etc}

entries.title: Psalms 143:8
segments: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

words.text: ; for in thee do I trust

entries.title: Psalms 143:9
segments: Deliver me, O LORD, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me. {flee...: Heb. hide me with thee}

words.text: : I flee unto thee to hide
me. {flee...: Heb. hide me with thee}

entries.title: Psalms 143:10
segments: Teach me to do thy will; for thou [art] my God: thy spirit [is] good; lead me into the land of uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 143:11
segments: Quicken me, O LORD, for thy name's sake: for thy righteousness' sake bring my soul out of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 143:12
segments: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I [am] thy servant.
